summary.name: NAE stage 83 - Puerto Vallarta to Mascota, Mexico
summary.description: First stage of the Conquistadores section of TDA's North American Epic. Joining up with old friends for a new challenge. We should all arrive in Panama City in December. It was a long hot day with cool downhill to the finish in the Pueblo Magico of Mascota.
